finding.expected: Bind Codex usage extraction to the recognized machine-readable native usage event for the same invocation so unknown/unrecognized JSONL events cannot supply portable token_usage. Preserve exact mapping of input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, and output_tokens from valid terminal usage; preserve fail-soft handling for missing, malformed, partial, conflicting, or extra unsupported telemetry; preserve structural ResultPackage parsing, one native invocation, original failure behavior, and all existing TASK-065 non-goals. Add a deterministic regression proving an unknown event with an otherwise valid usage-shaped payload yields unavailable/null token telemetry.
finding.issue: The Codex token-usage extractor accepts a valid-looking usage mapping from any JSONL record that contains a usage field, without binding that telemetry to the provider-defined terminal usage event. Therefore an unknown or future Codex event carrying input_tokens/cached_input_tokens/output_tokens can be treated as trusted RUN_OBSERVATION telemetry. TASK-065 AC3 explicitly requires unknown provider events to fail soft to unavailable/null telemetry. Current Codex JSONL usage is emitted on the terminal turn.completed event, so accepting usage-shaped data from unrelated event types widens telemetry trust beyond the authorized native contract.
